title: ALMA survey of Class II protoplanetary disks in Corona Australis: a young region with low disk masses
question: How do the dust masses of Class II disks in Corona Australis compare with those in other star-forming regions, and why are they low?

what.value: Mm fluxes/upper limits and dust masses of Lupus, Taurus, Cha I, Upper Sco, sigma Ori, IC348 for comparison

evidence.quote: with the continuum fluxes (or the $3\,\sigma$ upper limits) from our ALMA data or from the literature

what.value: Spectral types, extinctions, 2MASS J magnitudes from literature

evidence.quote: The spectral type for the targets were obtained from the literature (see Tab. [\[tab:stellarprop\]](#tab:stellarprop)) or from the VLT/X-Shooter spectra.

recipe.method: Manual CASA calibration; joint MFS clean imaging of three epochs with primary beam correction
Gaussian fit in the image plane (two Gaussians for binaries); rms by imstat
key_parameters: Detection threshold >=4 sigma within 1" of Spitzer position; rms for non-detections within 1" radius, for detections in 2"-4" annulus

recipe.method: Images centered on Spitzer coordinates and stacked
Spectral types from X-Shooter indices; Teff, L from J-band and BC; masses from tracks
assumptions: Cardelli reddening law, R_V=3.1; distance 154 pc

recipe.method: Optically thin isothermal relation M=F d^2/(kappa B(T))
key_parameters: kappa=2.3 cm2/g at 230 GHz; T_dust=20 K; d=154 pc

recipe.goal: Compare average dust masses across regions
key_parameters: Only stars with M*>=0.1 Msun included

recipe.method: Bayesian linear regression with censoring (linmix), 100 random draws for missing stellar masses; T CrA and TY CrA excluded

recipe.goal: Test stellar-mass effect via Monte Carlo logrank
recipe.method: Draw equal numbers per stellar mass bin from CrA and comparison sample, two-sample logrank test for censored data, 10^4 repetitions

evidence.quote: The total number of detections is therefore 24 out of the 43 targeted disks, so the detection rate is $\sim56\%$ .
